retrieval_limits: Human completed ICC CAPTCHA; the unlocked 2025 index was read through the browser. Exact public PDF links were downloaded, hashed and rendered for review; no CAPTCHA bypass.
The web reader returned 502 for the historical ICC price table; ordinary direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded. Its current revision is hashed and retained.
The bare Contentstack Ratebook.pdf and ICC currentbooks [186] informational-sheet URL now return 2026 revisions despite cached 2025 search text. Their former 2025 snippets were not used as rates.
2025 July book sheet9 footer says March 2024 but its applicability tables identify 2025; the stamped October revision confirms April-October 2025 DRAF17.0696%.

2025 December book sheet63 footer says November13,2026 although filed November12,2025. Its table identifies Oct-Dec2025; the year index records the 2025 filing. The application window is retained without silently editing the source.

RBAF explicitly not applicable before Jan2026. TPAF first reconciliation follows the May2025 annual proceeding and is filed Dec2025 for Jan2026. LID initial informational tables begin Jan2026. No 2026 factor is backfilled into 2025.
ERM25-033 ICC receipt stamp/index date is March19,2025; PDF footer says March20,2025. Effective date is March21; explicit April2025 table establishes applicability. Both original dates preserved.

ERM25-027 ICC receipt stamp/index is March14,2025; PDF footer says March14/15,2024. Explicit Jan-Mar2025/Apr-Dec2025 tables and later ERM25-168 corroborate the 2025 DRAF. No footer is silently edited.

January-May2026 supply/UF/REA/ZEA and monthly PEA/HPEA/CFRA/LID/CTS/ECR were verified separately. Annual delivery bases, RBAF, TPAF, EDAF, DGRA, EE, ETAC and RCA tables explicitly identify2026 applicability. June forecast supply values in ERM26-068 are superseded and not used.

cycle_rules.applicability: Utility-designated billing month and whole meter cycle. Fixed charges once; MKD once per documented cycle.
